C-266.note: Private member's bill for a national framework on skilled trades and labour mobility. Passed 2nd reading 295–21; HUMA did clause-by-clause on Nov 17.
C-266.short: Skilled trades and labour mobility framework; clause-by-clause done at HUMA, report to the House next.

C-34.note: Government's Safe Social Media Act. Would bring designated AI chatbot services under a duty-of-care regime. Passed 2nd reading Oct 29; now in committee.
C-34.short: Safe Social Media Act covers AI chatbots; in committee after 2nd reading Oct 29.

C-36.note: Government bill enacting the Protecting Privacy and Consumer Data Act; its text includes provisions on automated decision systems. At 2nd reading in the House.
C-36.short: Privacy reform with automated decision-making rules; still at 2nd reading.

C-297.note: Private member's bill: automated personalized pricing would become reviewable conduct under the Competition Act. Introduced Nov 23.
C-297.short: New bill targets algorithmic personalized pricing under the Competition Act.

C-277.note: Private member's bill to regulate online use of deepfakes. Outside the order of precedence, so unlikely to be debated soon.
